gaps.explanation: p6 governmental funds statement: Issuance of debt 151,760,000 is printed only in the Nonmajor Governmental Funds column. Detail = Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax Fund 'Issuance of debt' 40,000,000 (p32, a nonmajor fund). Adding the Nonmajor cell would double count the 40,000,000, and adding 151,760,000 - 40,000,000 = 111,760,000 would be a derived figure; that 111,760,000 was issued by nonmajor funds that have no budget schedule in the trim (combining nonmajor statements not trimmed) - not fixable. Separately, the General Fund column prints Issuance of long-term lease 1,252,711 and Issuance of subscriptions 1,480,473 (p6); the General Fund budget schedule (pp12-13) has no other financing section, so neither is in detail - both added as printed (they are in JSON other_financing, not debt_proceeds, so they do not change this gap's 111,760,000).
